## XRD-Scherrer v1.2.2

Fixes `(111)` crystallite size overestimation across multi-peak Williamson–Hall, single-peak fitting, and the built-in PtCo L1₀ synthetic demo.

### Download

Download **XRD-Scherrer-v1.2.2.html** from Assets and open it directly in your browser. It is a self-contained zero-dependency application with no installation or network requirement. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies the HTML.

### Changes

- **Consistent 1-peak Pseudo-Voigt LM fitting (`analyzeLM1`):**
  - Added `1-peak LM (Pseudo-Voigt)` row mode in Tab ③ and `Pseudo-Voigt LM (joint linear baseline)` in Tab ①, eliminating endpoint-baseline chord truncation that previously shrank measured `(111)` widths by >10% and inflated `D(111)` on Voigt/Lorentzian-tailed peaks.
  - Updated `+ Load PtCo L1₀ (5 peaks)` to fit `(111)` (`35.5°–44.5°`) with `1-peak LM` alongside `(200)/(002)` (`43.5°–51.5°`, avoiding the `53.6°` `(201)` superlattice tail) and `(220)/(202)` (`64°–75°`) so all 5 reflections share one consistent Pseudo-Voigt model.
- **Physically consistent PtCo L1₀ demo pattern:**
  - Replaced the legacy hardcoded `(111)` width (`σ = 0.5945° → 6.01 nm` vs `4.26–4.81 nm` on `(200)/(002)/(220)/(202)`, W–H `R² = 0.19`) with a consistent Williamson–Hall Pseudo-Voigt model (`D = 4.6 nm, ε = 0.0015, η = 0.25`), giving consistent sizes across all 5 reflections (`4.14–4.33 nm`, summary `4.27 ± 0.08 nm`) and W–H `R² > 0.91`.
- **Automatic `(111)` diagnostic note:**
  - Added a bilingual diagnostic hint in Tab ③ when measured `(111)` size still exceeds the median of other reflections by >25% (e.g., bimodal small+large crystallites or FCC/L1₀ anisotropic strain/stacking faults).
- **Regression tests:** Added tests verifying that `analyzeLM1` removes endpoint-baseline overestimation on Voigt `(111)` peaks and that PtCo L1₀ 5-peak analysis recovers consistent `(111)` size and W–H `R² > 0.85`.
